label: KO
text: $96.99, +0.94% Friday — the only gainer in the direct list — though still −2.28% on the week. Barron's flagged the richest valuation in 25 years (~$98/share against a $112 target), and a single session of roughly $176m of ETF selling interrupted a run of institutional buying; the October print remains the support (Q3 revenue +7%, organic +7%, operating margin 33.4%, guidance raised for a third straight quarter).
